document_title: Process Characterization Report — Protein A Chromatography (Step 5)
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
schema_extensions_used: ProvenAcceptableRange (new model) — per-response x parameter PAR (at-set-point / NOR-propagated), measured against the in-process limit for the pool where the drug-substance criterion does not apply at this step
RhetoricalSpan (new model) — argument-structure roles over the report prose
out_of_schema_notes: Pool host cell protein is an in-process response judged against an in-process limit carried back from the drug-substance limit through the CEX and AEX clearance; the train-wide position is deferred to PCR-007 / PCR-008 / PCMR-001.

Leached Protein A is a robustness result, not a modelled response: no parameter is significant and the fitted surface is retained as knowledge-space evidence only. It is carried as a StudyDesign response and in report_sections, never as a predictive model.
Process-capability (Cpk) values have no dedicated field; reported as report_sections statements.

rhetorical_spans are verbatim report prose; the leached-Protein-A cluster (claim + statistical justifications + the bounded_conclusion that retains the model as knowledge-space evidence only) is the report's central argument; PCR-005 carries no weak_claims.

process_steps.description: Affinity capture on Protein A resin, operated in bind-and-elute mode: binds the antibody from clarified harvest, is the principal point of host cell protein and residual DNA removal, and sets leached Protein A — the only quality attribute the step forms. Makes no viral-clearance and no aggregate-clearance claim, and does not modify the attributes formed in cell culture.

source_references.quote: Protein A chromatography is the capture step of the A-Mab drug substance process and the first chromatographic operation in the purification train
A scale-down chromatography system was qualified as a model of the manufacturing-scale step under SOP-1001

parameters.rationale_for_criticality: Carries a large effect on pool host cell protein — the impurity load the polishing steps have to handle — and is reliably controlled within its normal operating range, so the risk of an undetected excursion is low.

statements.statement_text: Two parameters are classified WC-CPP, two KPP and two GPP, and no parameter of the step required designation as a critical process parameter.

source_references.quote: No parameter at this step was classified as a critical process parameter.

statements.statement_text: Protein load and elution buffer pH are the two well-controlled critical process parameters, both through their effect on pool host cell protein.

source_references.quote: Elution buffer pH is classified as a well-controlled critical process parameter.

statements.statement_text: The design space is the multivariate region in all four multivariate parameters, and the operative constraint is a joint one on protein load and elution buffer pH; load flow rate and end of pool collect do not bound it.

source_references.quote: Load flow rate and end of pool collect do not bound the region within the characterized ranges

statements.statement_text: Pool host cell protein is well described and its predicted coefficient of determination supports prediction; step yield is adequate but descriptive.

source_references.quote: Pool host cell protein is modelled well.

statements.statement_text: Leached Protein A showed no significant parameter effect; its model is retained as knowledge-space evidence of that robustness and is not used predictively.

source_references.quote: This report therefore makes no predictive use of it, with the treatment of the attribute set out below

statements.statement_text: The operative result for leached Protein A is model-free: all 47 pools assayed met the 5 ppm acceptance criterion.

source_references.quote: However, the criterion applied here is the drug-substance specification, which is applied to the capture pool conservatively

statements.statement_text: The drug-substance host cell protein criterion applies to the drug substance and not to the Protein A pool, so the pool is judged against an in-process limit carried back through the clearance the polishing steps deliver.

source_references.quote: An intermediate has to be judged against a criterion that applies to an intermediate.

statements.statement_text: At drug substance the three impurity attributes the step governs all clear their limits with margin, and that margin is the combined result of three clearance steps.

source_references.quote: those figures are a statement about the process as a whole and not about this step alone

source_reference.quote: Pool host cell protein is the response that bounds the operating region
The normal operating range is not wholly inside the acceptable region
Leached Protein A produced no model of predictive value
For this reason the claim for this attribute is made from the assayed pools without a model
The remaining clearance is delivered by cation exchange (PCR-007) and anion exchange (PCR-008), while no viral clearance is claimed for this step
These results are rolled up into the master report PCMR-001
Leached Protein A is formed at this step and at no other, since it is the affinity ligand released from the resin under the elution condition

Leached Protein A is assigned by the platform to the resin life-cycle programme (SOP-2008) as much as to the operating parameters, because ligand release accumulates with cycle number and sanitization history
The analysis reported in §5.3 was framed by that expectation
It supports claims about the operating ranges and about the clearance a single cycle delivers, without saying anything about how the resin behaves after many cycles
Model adequacy is reported as the coefficient of determination, the adjusted coefficient, the predicted coefficient computed from the PRESS statistic
A response for which no factor reaches significance is treated as robust over the ranges studied, in which case the factors are kept in the knowledge space as evidence of that robustness
The response-surface model is the predictive model of this report
Leached Protein A returned no significant term at all
A negative adjusted coefficient on a near-saturated fit means the terms explain less than their degrees of freedom cost, which is the signature of a null result
The response-surface stage produced one model that is adequate and predictive, one that is adequate, and one that is neither
Leached Protein A yielded no usable model

Leaching of the affinity ligand behaves as a resin property over these ranges, since ligand release depends on the chemistry of the immobilization, on the cumulative cycle count and on the sanitization history, none of which is a parameter of a single run
The leached Protein A model is retained as knowledge-space evidence and is put to no other use in this report
A negative predicted coefficient means the model predicts a held-out run worse than the mean of the data predicts
A non-significant result here therefore says only that the quadratic form is not contradicted by a noisy replicate set, which is not evidence that the model predicts
For this reason the result bounds the evidence for the model form without establishing it
A predicted coefficient close to the adjusted coefficient means the model predicts a held-out run about as well as it fits the data used to build the model
The operative claim for leached Protein A is therefore made from the assayed pools directly

Elution buffer pH governs pool host cell protein because it sets the aggressiveness of desorption: a lower pH releases the antibody faster and also releases the more tightly associated host cell protein, which then co-elutes into the collected pool
Load flow rate and end of pool collect do not bound the region within the characterized ranges
the whole region rests on the scale-down model qualified in §3.1, which was qualified on performance attributes and not on resin life-cycle behaviour
Leached Protein A is cleared downstream of this step by cation exchange and anion exchange (PCR-007, PCR-008)
Given that the model explains no more than chance, this narrowing should be read as an artefact of propagating a null model instead of as a demonstrated pH effect
They describe operation within the normal operating range and say nothing about the excursion corners discussed in §6
The absence of a critical process parameter follows from control capability and not from an absence of effect

Both well-controlled critical parameters have a demonstrated effect on a critical quality attribute, while both are held by instrumentation and by released buffers that make an excursion outside the design space unlikely and detectable
The consolidated control strategy, including the cumulative clearance and the parameter classes across the whole train, is given in PCMR-001
Step yield is described adequately and matters for process consistency rather than for quality, whereas leached Protein A is described by no model at all
What is known about the attribute comes from the assayed pools and from the resin life-cycle programme
The affected run was analysed at the delivered setting and the deviation was dispositioned as retained
Consequently, the run remained inside the region the response-surface model covers, with no extrapolation introduced
The pH meter was within calibration, the buffer components were within specification and the endpoint was called early by the operator
